name: Equinix MC1 Muscat IBX - Barka
notes: Equinix/Omantel MC1 opened in October 2020 in Barka, South Al Batinah, with 23,600+ sq ft and 725 cabinets, expandable to 2,150 cabinets. Carrier-neutral subsea and interconnection hub; MW capacity not disclosed.

name: Ooredoo Barka Tier 3 data centre and 2Africa cable landing facility
notes: Ooredoo announced new Tier 3 data centres in Barka, Salalah and Sohar in 2022; 2024 2Africa reporting says Barka and Salalah are being built as cable landing facilities, each with more than 500 racks. No MW figure published.

name: Oman Digital Triangle - Barka digital hub / AI super-cluster
developer: Sultanate of Oman MTCIT / International Data Center Authority
notes: National agreement covers the Oman Digital Triangle, described as three interconnected digital hubs and AI super-clusters with GW-scale capacities. Trade coverage of COMEX 2025 identifies Barka, Duqm and Sur as the three nodes; exact site, phase and MW per node not disclosed.

name: Ooredoo Sohar data centre
notes: Official Ooredoo launch notice says the Sohar facility launched on November 3, 2024 with 1,200 racks, up to 10 MW power supply, and Level 3+ standards.

name: Oman Data Park Firq / Nizwa data centre
developer: Oman Data Park / Otech; Solar Wadi solar component
notes: DCD reports ODP's planned Firq, Nizwa data center will have 4.4 MW total power and integrated solar infrastructure contributing about 350 kW from launch. Listed as planned because the 2025 source calls it planned/upcoming.

name: Ooredoo Bausher / Muscat flagship Tier 3 data centre
notes: Ooredoo's Muscat/Bausher flagship Tier 3 facility launched in March 2021 with 2.5 MW power capacity and about 7,000 square meters; sources cite it as serving Ooredoo/Data2Cloud hosting and processing workloads.

name: Oman Data Park KOM 4 / Rusayl data centre
notes: DCD identifies KOM 4 in Rusayl as an existing ODP data center receiving a 1.4 MW onsite solar project, with a planned 400 kW expansion. ODP materials list Rusayl among its Level 3 in-country data centers; IT MW not disclosed.

name: Oman Data Park Wattayah data centre
notes: Oman Data Park's service page says data is stored in three Level 3 data centres: Al Wattayah, Rusayl and Duqm. DCD's Duqm article describes Wattayah as one of ODP's earlier 12,000 sq ft facilities west of Muscat. MW capacity not disclosed.

name: Oman Digital Triangle - Sur digital hub / AI super-cluster
developer: Sultanate of Oman MTCIT / International Data Center Authority
notes: The Oman Digital Triangle agreement is national; trade coverage of COMEX 2025 places one of the three planned green data-center/digital-zone nodes in Sur, in Southeastern/Ash Sharqiyah South. Exact land parcel and MW allocation not disclosed.

name: Oman Data Park Duqm data centre
notes: DCD reported the ODP-funded Duqm data center was expected online in December 2017 for SEZAD, and ODP now lists Duqm among its Level 3 in-country data centres. 2024 market release says ODP's Duqm facility was built to Uptime Tier III standards; MW capacity not disclosed.

name: Oman Digital Triangle - Duqm digital hub / AI super-cluster
developer: Sultanate of Oman MTCIT / International Data Center Authority
notes: The Oman Digital Triangle is described as three interconnected hubs and AI super-clusters; trade coverage identifies Duqm as one of the three planned nodes. Exact site and per-node MW not disclosed.
